Are all three pens aligned identically, all pointing the same way, including any pen near the left or right frame edge as it enters or exits?

Is every pen fully capped with no exposed writing tip, and are all three pens equal in length?
Does the board advance steadily from left to right at EVERY moment, never halting, freezing, or pausing even briefly (1-3 seconds) at any point in the video?
Do all pens stay fixed in their positions on the board, with no pen shifting, sliding, or moving on its own relative to the board mid-clip?

The leftmost item is grey and lacks a black cap, differing from the other two which have black caps.
The leftmost item shows a pointed tip (like a pencil or uncapped pen) while the others are capped. The rightmost pen is oriented oppositely to the middle one.
The board moves steadily from left to right throughout the clip without halting or reversing.
The pens remain fixed in their positions on the board as it slides.

parsed.reason: The video shows multiple anomalies: the rightmost pen is flipped (cap up) relative to the middle pen (cap down), and the leftmost item appears to be a different instrument (grey, pointed tip/uncapped) compared to the black-capped pens.
